reason: The README clearly describes a Cordis plugin that integrates WeChat through the Tencent iLink bot protocol as a second DSH agent client, supporting bidirectional message and media transfer, session commands, notifications, and approval-card interaction.

summaries.zh: 通过腾讯 iLink bot 协议将微信私聊与 DSH agent 双向连接，支持文本、图片、文件和语音消息以及会话管理与通知。
summaries.en: Connects WeChat private chats to DSH agents through the Tencent iLink bot protocol, supporting bidirectional text, image, file, and voice messages with session controls and notifications.

capabilities: Connects to the Tencent iLink WeChat bot service
Bridges text, image, file, and voice messages between WeChat and DSH agents
Provides WeChat commands for DSH workspace, session, preset, model, permission, and task control
Relays approval and question cards between WeChat and the DSH GUI
Stores login state, session mappings, synchronization buffers, and temporary media files locally
Exposes a send_wechat agent tool for sending text and files to WeChat
